object_description: well-proportioned angled point building with a compact volume
design_condition: The concentrated point building is oriented toward Gotthelfstrasse and placed to preserve the existing trees, opening generous outdoor spaces at different heights while maintaining the district’s flowing green character.

positive.statement: The concentration of the day care in a point building opens generous outdoor spaces at different heights.
The preserved and newly planted trees strengthen the impression of flowing green space.
The angled geometry enables precise placement in relation to the street, terraced open space, and kindergarten.
The well-proportioned volume appears self-confident in its shape.
The bend accentuates the main entrance and cleverly locates the building on the street.
The large window areas logically support connections from inside to outside.
The deep parapets ensure a high level of light.
The floor-by-floor organization around the distribution core is rational and optimized.
The enfilade supports the spatial sequence and generates many perspectives and spatial references.
The technical requirements for acoustics and ventilation can be organized well.
The strict spatial organization has a certain flexibility of use.

negative.statement: The proposed use and design of the southern tip are not yet convincing.
The path connects all areas but also separates the green spaces from one another.
The obstacle-free connection and development of the outdoor spaces are not clearly shown.
The sliding-window solution remains questionable in terms of facade appearance, functionality, and safety.
The dirty and dry areas are mixed unfavorably in the central core.
The desired retreat options and child-friendly atmosphere still need to be proven.
One main staircase cannot achieve the necessary separation of the children’s groups.
The stair exits and toilet units create overly narrow spatial conditions.
The outdoor spaces of the individual units can only be reached via the main staircase.
The office space is not optimally designed.
There is insufficient space for bicycles and kickboards in front of the entrance.
